description.zh:
排序方向，取值：

- **desc**：递减（默认）。
- **asc**：递增。
description.en:
The sort order. Valid values:

- **desc**: descending (default)

- **asc**: ascending

description.zh: 处置的实体的名称。
description.en: The name of the entity to which the response is performed.

description.zh:
处置的实体类型，取值：

- **ip**：表示IP类型实体。
- **file**：表示文件类型实体。
- **process**：表示进程类型实体。
description.en:
The type of the entity to which the response is performed. Valid values:

- **ip**: an IP address.

- **file**: a file.

- **process**: a process.

description.zh: 实体UUID。
description.en: The UUID of the entity.

description.zh: 事件UUID。
description.en: The UUID of the event.

description.zh:
结果的排序字段。

> 排序的字段，由接口的返回结果中获取。
description.en:
The field by which to sort the query results.

> You can obtain the field from the response.

description.zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示。
description.en: The page number to return. Default value: 1. This value indicates the first page.

description.zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回10条数据。
> 建议PageSize取值不要为空。
description.en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20. If you do not specify this parameter, 10 entries are returned.

> Specify this parameter.

description.zh: 模糊匹配，会查询实体、处置场景、处置参数字段。
description.en: The keyword for a fuzzy search. The operation queries the entity, response scenario, and response parameter fields.

description.zh: 处置时间的查询结束时间，格式：13位的时间戳。
description.en: The end of the time range to query response tasks. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp.

description.zh: 处置时间的查询开始时间，格式：13位的时间戳。
description.en: The start of the time range to query response tasks. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp.

description.zh: 解封时间的查询结束时间，格式：13位的时间戳。
description.en: The end of the time range to query unblocking tasks. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp.

description.zh: 解封时间的查询开始时间，格式：13位的时间戳。
description.en: The start of the time range to query unblocking tasks. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp.

description.zh:
处置策略的UUID。
>调用[ListDisposeStrategy](~~2584440~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The UUID of the response policy.

> Call the [ListDisposeStrategy](~~2584440~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh: 剧本触发ID。
description.en: The playbook trigger ID.

description.zh:
处置任务的场景CODE。
>调用[DescribeEnumItems](~~DescribeEnumItems~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The code of the response scenario.

> Call the [DescribeEnumItems](~~DescribeEnumItems~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh: 处置的阿里云账户ID。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account for which the response task is performed.

description.zh:
处置任务的触发来源，为数组字符串格式，取值：

- **system**：手动处置事件触发。
- **custom**：自动响应规则，事件触发。
- **custom_alert**：自动响应规则，告警触发。
- **soar-manual**：SOAR手动调用剧本触发。
- **soar-mdr**：由安全管家服务触发。
description.en:
The source that triggers the response task. The value is a string in an array format. Valid values:

- **system**: The task is triggered by manually responding to an event.

- **custom**: The task is triggered by an automatic response rule for an event.

- **custom\_alert**: The task is triggered by an automatic response rule for an alert.

- **soar-manual**: The task is triggered by a playbook that is manually run in Security Orchestration Automation Response (SOAR).

- **soar-mdr**: The task is triggered by Managed Security Service.

description.zh:
处置任务的唯一标识。

> 用于查询某具体任务，参数可由接口的返回值中获取。
description.en:
The unique ID of the response task.

> Use this parameter to query a specific task. You can obtain the task ID from the response to a previous request.

The statuses of the response tasks. The value is a string in an array format. Valid values:

- **11**: The task is in progress.

- **21**: The entity is being blocked.

- **22**: The entity is in isolation.

- **23**: The task is complete.

- **24**: The entity is added to the whitelist.

- **20**: The task is successful.

- **90**: The task failed.

- **91**: Unblocking failed.

- **92**: Removing the entity from isolation failed.

description.zh:
处置任务的触发来源，取值：

- **system**：手动处置事件触发。
- **custom**：自动响应规则，事件触发。
- **custom_alert**：自动响应规则，告警触发。
- **soar-manual**：SOAR手动调用剧本触发。
- **soar-mdr**：由安全管家服务触发。
description.en:
The source that triggers the response task. Valid values:

- **system**: The task is triggered by manually responding to an event.

- **custom**: The task is triggered by an automatic response rule for an event.

- **custom\_alert**: The task is triggered by an automatic response rule for an alert.

- **soar-manual**: The task is triggered by a playbook that is manually run in SOAR.

- **soar-mdr**: The task is triggered by Managed Security Service.

description.zh:
处置任务关联的云产品，为数据字符串格式，取值：

- **WAF**：表示Web应用防火墙。
- **CFW**：表示云防火墙。
- **Aegis**：表示云安全中心。
description.en:
The cloud service associated with the response task. The value is a string in an array format. Valid values:

- **WAF**: Web Application Firewall

- **CFW**: Cloud Firewall

- **Aegis**: Security Center

descriptions.zh: 请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解响应编排产品（即威胁分析与响应日志接入流量）的收费方式和[价格](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product#/sas/detail/sas)。
descriptions.en: Before you call this operation, review the billing methods and [pricing](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product#/sas/detail/sas) for Threat Analysis and Response. Response orchestration is billed based on the volume of ingested log traffic.
